kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننصهر (form VII)
# نَنْصَهِرُ (nanṣahiru) /nan.sˤa.hi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# نَنْصَهِرَ (nanṣahira) /nan.sˤa.hi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# نَنْصَهِرْ (nanṣahir) /nan.sˤa.hir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
